title: useStep Hook
description:
Implement a `useStep` hook that moves through an array of steps and returns `{ current, index, next, prev, isFirst, isLast }`. Navigation is clamped — `next` does nothing on the last step and `prev` does nothing on the first.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { current, index, next, prev, isFirst, isLast } = useStep(['intro', 'form', 'confirm']);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: confusing useCycle (wrapping) with useStep (clamped) — learners often apply the modulo wrap from useCycle here, when useStep should clamp at boundaries instead.
